text_block_list.text: A-a reward?! I... I see... A reward...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Forgive me for being so taken aback.
Respect
and gratitude, I am used to, but
not... rewards.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Heh. You somehow always manage to
confound
my expectations.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But your sentiment is reward enough. I
have no
need of gifts.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But of course. This victory was but a
single step
on my road to glory.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It is a long and arduous road, but I shall
not rest
until I have reached the end.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
After all, what greater reward could
there be than
the chance to vie with
other Umamusume on the
track?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And of course, you will accompany me
every step
of the way.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
